technology_name: A METHOD FOR DETERMINING JOINTLY THE CARRIER FREQUENCY OFFSET (CFO), TIMING OFFSET, AND CHANNEL CO-EFFICIENTS IN AN ORTHOGONAL FREQUENCY DIVISION MULTIPLE ACCESS (OFDMA) UPLINK WIRELESS COMMUNICATION SYSTEM
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Wireless Uplink Algorithm / Signal Processing Framework
problem_solved: OFDMA uplink systems suffer severe inter-carrier interference and signal distortion when multi-user carrier frequency offsets (CFO) and fast timing misalignments are calculated separately.
description: An advanced, joint optimization mathematical algorithm that estimates multi-user communication metrics by executing an iterative multidimensional search across sub-space noise margins, subsequently reconstructing data blocks via an incorporated channel drive filter.
applications: 5G/6G cellular base station receivers, high-density IoT wireless gateways, autonomous swarm drone communications, and high-speed satellite uplink processing.
